events.description: A large, violent explosion occurs at a fireworks factory, producing a massive fireball, intense orange-red flames, and a rapidly expanding plume of dark smoke and debris; multiple secondary detonations and sparks are visible.

A large, sustained explosion with massive fireball and dense black/gray smoke plume rising from an industrial or storage facility; multiple secondary detonations and debris ejection visible across the sequence.

A large, sustained explosion with massive fireball, dense black and grey smoke plume, and visible shockwave/fragment ejection occurring at an industrial or fuel-storage facility; multiple secondary detonations and fireballs are visible across the sequence.

A large, violent explosion occurs at an industrial or commercial site, producing a rapidly expanding fireball, intense flash, and massive plume of dark smoke and debris. The blast wave is visible distorting the air and lifting dust/objects. Multiple frames show the initial detonation and immediate aftermath with shockwave propagation.
A secondary, smaller explosion or fireball erupts within the smoke cloud, likely from a secondary fuel source or structural collapse, visible as a bright orange flash amid the dark smoke column.

A large, violent explosion occurs at the industrial/commercial site, producing a rapidly expanding fireball and a massive plume of dark smoke rising vertically; debris is visibly ejected upward in frames f0–f2.

A secondary or continuing explosive event is visible as a bright vertical jet of fire and debris erupts from the same location (left side of the complex), coinciding with the initial smoke column’s expansion; this appears distinct from the first blast and persists through f3–f5.

A third distinct explosive pulse is observed around 33.0–34.5 s: a new bright flash and upward ejection of material appear near the left-center of the site (near the tall chimney), separate in timing and position from earlier blasts, visible in f10–f13.

A large, sustained plume of thick black smoke rises continuously from a cluster of structures in the distance, indicating an ongoing major fire or series of explosions. The smoke column expands and billows throughout the sequence, with visible fire flashes and debris movement in early frames (e.g., f0–f2), consistent with explosive ignition and structural collapse.

Large, sustained plume of thick black and grey smoke rising from a settlement, indicating a major fire or series of explosions; visible flames and intense smoke generation persist across all frames from f0 to f14, with no clear single blast but consistent explosive-scale combustion.
Massive plume of dark smoke rising rapidly from a ground-level incident, with visible fire and structural disruption in the background; consistent with a large explosion or detonation event.

Groups of people are seen moving erratically near the smoke source, some appearing to flee or converge; however, no clear evidence of violent group clashes, throwing objects, or destruction beyond the explosion site is visible. Given the context of a sudden large-scale incident, this may reflect panic or response rather than organized unrest. Confidence lowered due to ambiguity.
